description: Collaborated on a full-stack suncarbon DMRV system for biomass pyrolysis and carbon credit generation. Maintained a React Native app integrated with RESTful APIs supporting 200+ artisans and sellers. Developed a scalable Node.js + PostgreSQL backend. Optimized response times by 80% using server-side pagination. Reduced page load time by 40% using lazy loading and accordions.

Built a React Native + Expo mobile app for remote gate control with geolocation access. Implemented role-based access control (RBAC) for various user tiers. Integrated Paho-MQTT for real-time IoT communication. Designed UI using React Native Paper, Navigation, and Reanimated. Supported 100+ gates and 500+ concurrent users.
